description: This source file defines the PasswordHash class, which provides a wrapper around PHP's password_hash and password_verify functions for hashing and verifying passwords using bcrypt algorithm. It includes constants for algorithm selection and cost parameter, and two methods: hash() and verify().

classes.name: PasswordHash
classes.description: A utility class that wraps PHP's password hashing functions for secure password handling.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash of the provided password using a predefined cost parameter.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a given password against a stored hash using PHP's password_verify function.
